misc: Primary organizer of the Hector Trophée event.
biography: Toni stands as the undisputed heart and visionary architect of the Hector Trophée, having gracefully shouldered the monumental responsibility of serving as the primary organizer for the esteemed pair competition since its inception. Representing the immaculate fairways of Hirsala Golf, this remarkable competitor has maintained an unbroken record of participation across all 13 distinct editions of the tournament, anchoring his status as an indispensable pillar of the community where he remains fully active to this day.

Beyond his tireless behind-the-scenes dedication to orchestrating every successful gathering, Toni has etched his name permanently into the event's record books through truly staggering competitive dominance. He has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on four separate occasions, cementing his legacy among the most successful team champions in the history of the event. Furthermore, his exceptional individual brilliance is underscored by an astonishing three victories of the prestigious Victor Trophy.

Away from the tournament pressure cooker, Toni is known among his companions for a wonderfully vibrant imagination and an obsessive fascination with vintage sci-fi literature, often spending his quiet evenings immersed in interstellar epics with the same focused intensity he brings to reading tricky greens. As he remains fully invested in the vibrant community surrounding the event, observers eagerly anticipate his next return, knowing well that Toni will unfailingly deliver a masterclass in both visionary leadership and unmatched championship pedigree.
